summary: ServiceCode class and its associated methods provide a way to manage service codes, including retrieval by course ID or timetable ID, supporting both primary and alternative language fields.
purpose: Manage service codes linked to courses and timetables with alternative language support.

workflows.name: Service Code Management
steps: ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID retrieves service codes by course ID.
Localize method adjusts field names based on language settings.

business_rules: Use alt-language data if running in alt language mode.
